I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/libxml2`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
Stack-use-after-scope in xmlEscapeText (xmlIO.c): xmlEscapeText uses data from a stack-allocated temporary buffer after that buffer's lifetime ends, causing a read of stale stack memory (observed via a memcpy). This is reachable via node string handling / element validation (xmlNodeListGetStringInternal -> xmlValidateElement) and can lead to crashes or other memory-corruption impacts when parsing crafted XML.

import cpp

from Function f, LocalVariable temp, LocalVariable repl, AssignExpr a, Call c
where
  f.getName() = "xmlEscapeText" and
  temp.getName() = "tempBuf" and
  temp.getType() instanceof ArrayType and
  repl.getName() = "repl" and

  a.getEnclosingFunction() = f and
  a.getLValue() instanceof VariableAccess and
  a.getLValue().(VariableAccess).getTarget() = repl and
  a.getRValue() instanceof VariableAccess and
  a.getRValue().(VariableAccess).getTarget() = temp and

  c.getEnclosingFunction() = f and
  c.getTarget().getName() = "memcpy" and
  c.getArgument(1) instanceof VariableAccess and
  c.getArgument(1).(VariableAccess).getTarget() = repl
select c, a, "'repl' is assigned the address of stack array 'tempBuf' and later used as memcpy source; potential stack-use-after-scope."
